responsibility: Defines the AMD GCN machine-description operand constraints used by reload, instruction selection, and asm matching. It classifies immediate encodings such as inline scalar/vector constants and split 64-bit literals, names the major scalar/vector/condition register classes, and describes target-specific memory/address-space constraints for scratch, flat, scalar-flat, LDS, GDS, and global memory operands, relying on helper predicates from the C backend to distinguish legal encodings and addressing forms.
